name: Reaver
theme: Apotheosis of the Eternal Frenzy. Walks in at 1 HP, walks out with 30 corpses; cannot die while Rage burns.
designNotes: Capstone effect mirrors §10.1: 'Each kill while Frenzied extends the Frenzied window by 2s. Cannot die while Rage is active.'
Pairs with berserker.json reaver path — same id, mirrors path-7 capstone Undying Wrath + amplifies.
8-node compact tree, 3 tiers, ~24 total ranks. Tier-3 capstone gates on Iron Skin.

Engine wiring status (2026-05-05): 7 of 8 wireable today — heaviest Berserker wire-rate due to foundation life/leech stats and bleed-baseline interactions. Frenzied state extension + lethal-hit immunity (Undying Wrath capstone) are decorative until Phase F lands the Rage Threshold mechanic.

nodes.name: Wound Tolerance
nodes.description: +5/10/15/20/25 maximum HP (foundation reservoir for the low-HP fantasy).

nodes.name: Bloodlet
nodes.description: +1/2/3/4/5 life on hit (sustain through the Bloodied window).

nodes.name: Reckless
nodes.description: +1/2/3% crit chance (foundation — pairs with Bloody Crit's bleed application).

nodes.name: Bloody Crit
nodes.description: On crit, +5/10/15/20/25% chance to apply 2 additional Bleed stacks (deepens Bloodied stack engine on top of base bleed application).

nodes.name: Iron Skin
nodes.description: +5% damage taken reduction (defensive backbone for the low-HP commitment).

nodes.name: Wrath Sustain
nodes.description: +1/2/3% lifesteal — damage dealt returns as healing (the engine of Eternal Frenzy).

nodes.name: Undying Wrath
nodes.description: Each kill while Frenzied extends the Frenzied window by 2 seconds. Cannot die while Rage is active — you stop at 1 HP (once per encounter, 90s cooldown). The §10.1 ascendancy keystone.
